name: Aurelius
source:
It is a well-known rumour that the third prince, carried by a concubine, may not be blood-related to the late King. Nonetheless, Aurelius is respected not only for his outstanding abilities in combat but also as an excellent strategist.

Foulmouthed and arrogant as he might be, prove yourself as his equal and you'll find a strong ally by your side.
